THE SKY IS COLORFUL. THE TEAMWORK IS EXTRAORDINARY. 🎈

Behind a sky full of hot air balloons is a small army of people making the magic happen.

In a fresh November 5 report from this October’s Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta, General Aviation News highlights more than 1,000 volunteers—beyond the balloon crews themselves—working across more than 40 roles.

Known as Navigators, they help with setup, logistics, guest services, parking, safety and balloon coordination. Launch officials guide departures while crews help inflate, launch, retrieve and pack the aircraft.

It’s a wonderful reminder that aviation is a team sport. The pilot may be in the basket, but a successful flight starts with the people holding the lines and continues with those meeting it on the ground.

Here’s to the volunteers, families and crews who turn early alarms and hard work into a sky full of possibility. 💛

Source: Geremy Kornreich, General Aviation News, November 5, 2026. Reporting on the October 2026 event.
